description: Registry of temperature-controlled EWM storage types targeted by this agent. Each entry maps a storage type code to its label, temperature range, and capacity unit preference.

storage_types.label: Cryo Freezer
storage_types.description: Ultra-low temperature freezer storage for cryogenic materials such as biological samples, vaccines requiring deep-freeze storage

storage_types.label: Ultra-Cold Refrigerator
storage_types.description: Ultra-cold refrigerator storage for materials requiring sub-zero but non-cryogenic temperatures

storage_types.label: Controlled Cold Room
storage_types.description: Controlled cold room / refrigerator storage for materials requiring standard refrigeration

notes: Storage type codes must match EWMStorageType values configured in the connected SAP EWM system.
Update the 'code' fields to match your system's actual EWM storage type codes.
The capacity_unit_preference list defines the fallback order when resolving capacity values from API responses.
Ambient storage types are explicitly out of scope for this agent.
